newEntry.name: Scoop & Sweep
newEntry.desc: Snip sixteen runners and seat two rising cheeks plus a rear wall in six calibrated floor joints for a four-panel miniature desk scoop. Measured sheet/socket reference, customizable floor and lip, local PNG/JPEG/SVG relief and verified ASCII/binary STL handle grips; connected-card and per-part STL/ZIP. Adhesive required; dry scraps only, not food-safe or watertight.
